{{Quote|I can't see ever using such a Mark.|Obi-Wan Kenobi regarding the ''mou kei'' Mark of Contact|<ref name="The Jedi Path">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>}}
The '''''mou kei''''' was a devastating finishing move in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] involving the cutting off of several [[Limb/Legends|limbs]] at once.<ref name="The Jedi Path" /> It became a rare move to use.

==Methodology==
[[File:MouKeiJungMa-SOC.png|thumb|left|200px|An Aqualish darksider utilizing [[jung ma]] to execute a mou kei slash.]]
''Mou kei'' literally meant "to [[Dismemberment/Legends|dismember]]." This was accomplished through the use of a series of circular motions with the lightsaber aimed at the major limbs. The attack was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] favorite, as it completely destroyed the opponent, both figuratively and literally. Using this move with the goal of dismembering an opponent could have been viewed as little more than all-out butchery. Although [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] had no other choice against [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], its usage by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was forbidden given the many alternative Marks of Contact.<ref name="The Jedi Path" />

==Example(s)==
A ''mou kei'' strike was used by Obi-Wan Kenobi against Darth Vader during their [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|showdown]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], removing his left arm and both his legs and ending their duel.
